scope: Single-page Crawl4AI HTML recovery and native fleet connection fragments

change_reconciliation.requirement_reason: Implement the requested provider fallback within existing native MCP ownership; no shared behavioral requirement, model preference or approval policy changes.
change_reconciliation.authority: User requested recovery of saved Reddit comments and Instagram profile HTML, automatic workflow fallback and fleet synchronization.
change_reconciliation.checks: 18 tests passed including real saved corpus; actual stdio MCP replay passed for both social responses; authenticated live MCP scrape recovered 25 Reddit comments; all 16 upstream tools listed; pinned dependency audit found no known vulnerabilities; independent review findings repaired.

outcome_review.expected: Recover only content present in returned public HTML and make that recovery automatic for single-page scrape in Codex, Hermes and OMP.
outcome_review.observed: Saved Reddit response yields 25 comment records; Instagram yields matching profile biography, name, counts and 5 public links with following-count conflict retained. Actual upstream MCP scrape yields the same 25-comment recovery through the stdio adapter.
outcome_review.evidence: Integration tests, saved-response MCP replay, real cloud MCP result, source hash provenance and dependency audit. Native deployment/readback is recorded separately after publication.
outcome_review.limitations: Only captured HTML is recoverable. No full-thread/profile completeness or freshness claim; no login, pagination or script execution. Automatic fallback is single-page scrape only, not batch/jobs. Existing sessions require reload. OMP exposes its full upstream catalog under existing approvals.

obligations.reason: Existing native tool/credential ownership remains intact; provider-specific runtime and recovery behavior are documented without changing shared behavioral requirements.
